exercises.instructionUz: Har bir suratni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri kasb bilan nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI KASB.

  a gardener    - bog'bon
  a stuntman    - kaskadyor
  a firefighter - o't o'chiruvchi
  a barman      - barmen
  a doctor      - shifokor
  a builder     - quruvchi


⚠ 'A STUNTMAN':

  = kaskadyor (kinoda xavfli sahnalarni
  bajaruvchi).
  ⚠ 'a stunt' = xavfli, mahoratli
  harakat.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi: 'stuntMEN'.


⚠ 'A FIREFIGHTER' va 'A FIREMAN':

  ⚠ 'a firefighter' - zamonaviy,
  jinsdan xoli so'z (30-betdagi
  hikoyada ham bor edi).
  ⚠ 'a fireman' - eski shakl
  (28-betdagi 9-mashqda).


⚠ 'A BARMAN' va 'A BARTENDER':

  Britaniyada 'a barman' / 'a barmaid',
  AQShda 'a bartender'.


⚠ 'A BUILDER':

  ⚠ 'to build' = qurmoq
  (build - built - built).
  ⚠ 'a building' = bino.


⚠ E SURATI - QIZIQ HOLAT:

  Sariq himoya kostyumidagi odam -
  bu O'T O'ChIRUVChI (firefighter),
  chunki bunday kostyum kimyoviy
  yong'inlarda ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Aynan shu surat 2-modul
  muqovasida ham bor edi.


⚠ 'TO LABEL':

  = yorliq qo'ymoq, nomlash.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'labelLED'
  (undosh IKKILANADI).

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Kinodagi xavfli sahna - bu KASKADYoR ishi.
⚠ 'a stunt' = xavfli, mahoratli harakat.
⚠ Ko'pligi 'stuntMEN'.

  ⚠ So'roq va inkorda 'any',

  'She is A teacher.'
  ⚠ 'She is teacher' - XATO.
  ⚠ 6-betdagi 2-mashqda ham
  tushuntirilgan edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SABAB VA KASB.

  ⚠ Har gap qolipi:
     SABAB + so + I'm going to be a KASB


⚠ 'BE GOING TO' - NIYAT:

  "I'm GOING TO BE a doctor."
  = shifokor bo'lmoqchiman.

  ⚠ 'be going to' - OLDINDAN
  o'ylangan NIYaT.
  ⚠ 'will' - shu daqiqada qabul
  qilingan qaror.

  ⚠ Bu - 5-unitning grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ 'SO' - NATIJA BOG'LOVChISI:

  'I like helping people, SO I'm going
   to be a doctor.'
  = ... shuning uchun ...

  ⚠ 'because' esa SABABNI kiritadi:
  "I'm going to be a doctor BECAUSE I
   like helping people."

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'so' va 'because' - qismlarni
  TESKARI tartibda bog'laydi.


⚠ FE'LDAN KEYIN -ING:

  I like MEETING people
  I enjoy DOING dangerous things
  I love LOOKING AFTER plants
  I don't mind WORKING hard

  ⚠ like, enjoy, love, mind, hate -
  hammasidan keyin -ING shakli.
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 2-mashqda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO LOOK AFTER':

  = qaramoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to look FOR' = qidirmoq
  ⚠ 'to look AT' = qaramoq
  ⚠ Uchalasi BUTUNLAY boshqa ma'noda!


⚠ 'TO SAVE LIVES':

  = hayot saqlab qolmoq.
  ⚠ 'a life' → ko'plikda 'liVES'
  (-fe → -ves).


⚠ 'TO SOCIALISE':

  = odamlar bilan aralashmoq.
  ⚠ 'society' (jamiyat) so'zidan.
  ⚠ 8-betdagi 14-mashqda 'sociable'
  bor edi.

exercises.instructionUz: 1a mashqidagi kasblar haqida gap tuzish uchun ro'yxatdan sifatlar tanlang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASB XISLATLARI (job qualities).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Gardeners HAVE TO BE patient,
   imaginative and careful.'


RO'YXATDAGI SIFATLAR:

  brave        - jasur
  patient      - sabrli
  imaginative  - tasavvuri boy
  strong       - kuchli
  friendly     - samimiy
  hardworking  - mehnatkash
  caring       - g'amxo'r
  careful      - ehtiyotkor


⚠ 'HAVE TO' - ZARURAT:

  'Gardeners HAVE TO BE patient.'
  = bog'bonlar sabrli BO'LIShI KERAK.

  ⚠ 'have to' - TAShQI zarurat
  (ish talabi).
  ⚠ 'must' - IChKI majburiyat
  (o'zi xohlaydi).

  ⚠ Bu 10-unitning grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ KO'PLIKDA GAP:

  'GardenerS have to be ...'
  ⚠ Umumiy gap uchun KO'PLIK
  ishlatiladi va artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'A gardener has to be ...' ham
  to'g'ri.


⚠ 'PATIENT' - IKKI MA'NO:

  patient (sifat) = sabrli
  a patient (ot) = bemor

  ⚠ Shifokor mavzusida ikkalasi ham
  uchraydi - ADAShTIRMANG.


⚠ 'CARING' va 'CAREFUL':

  caring = g'amxo'r (odamlarga
     mehribon)
  careful = ehtiyotkor (xato
     qilmaydigan)

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'care' so'zidan,
  lekin ma'nosi BOShQA.


⚠ 'HARDWORKING':

  = mehnatkash.
  ⚠ BIRGA yoziladi (ba'zan defis bilan:
  'hard-working').
  ⚠ 'hardly working' - BUTUNLAY teskari:
  'deyarli ishlamaydi'!

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Which job would you most like to
      do?
  SB: I'd like to work as a doctor,
      because I like helping sick
      people. Which job would you most
      like to do?
  SA: I'd like to ...


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE ...?':

  = ... xohlaysizmi?
  ⚠ 'Do you want ...?' dan ancha
  MULOYIM.
  ⚠ Keyin 'to' + fe'l keladi.


⚠ 'MOST' - QAYERDA TURADI:

  'Which job would you MOST like to do?'
  ⚠ 'most' bu yerda RAVISh: 'eng ko'p'.
  ⚠ 'like' fe'lidan OLDIN turadi.


⚠ 'TO WORK AS':

  = ... bo'lib ishlamoq.
  ⚠ Kasb oldidan 'AS' va ARTIKL:
  'work AS A doctor'.
  ⚠ 16-betdagi matnda ham bor edi:
  'I used to work AS A cleaner'.


⚠ 'BECAUSE' - SABAB:

  ⚠ 2-mashqda 'so' (natija) ishlatilgan
  edi, bu yerda 'because' (sabab).
  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir xil fikrni TESKARI
  tartibda ifodalaydi.


⚠ ZANJIRLI SAVOL:

  SB javob berib, KEYIN o'zi savol
  beradi ('Which job would you most
  like to do?').
  ⚠ Bu - suhbatni davom ettirish usuli;
  19-betdagi 6b mashqida ham shunday
  edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
UCh ODAM, UCh KASB, UCh SABAB.

  * ⚠ Ito qaysi kasbni xohlaydi va nega -
    audiodan
  * ⚠ Roberto qaysi kasbni xohlaydi va
    nega - audiodan
  * ⚠ Natasha qaysi kasbni xohlaydi va
    nega - audiodan


KASBLAR VA SABABLAR:

  doctor      - likes helping sick people
  firefighter - wants to save lives
  barman      - likes meeting people

  ⚠ Sabablar 2-mashqdagi gaplar bilan
  AYNI - shuning uchun kasb va sabab
  juftligi ALLAQAChON ma'lum:
     doctor → helping sick people
     firefighter → save lives
     barman → meeting people

  ⚠ Faqat KIM qaysi kasbni tanlagani
  audiodan bilinadi.


⚠ 'YOU ARE GOING TO HEAR':

  = eshitasiz.
  ⚠ 'be going to' - REJA yoki oldindan
  ma'lum ish.
  ⚠ Bu - 5-unitning grammatika mavzusi
  va u AYNAN topshiriq matnida
  ishlatilgan.


⚠ 'PLANS FOR THE FUTURE':

  = kelajak rejalari.
  ⚠ 'a plan FOR sth' - predlog 'for'.
  ⚠ 'the future' - HAR DOIM 'the' bilan.


⚠ 'THE REASON WHY':

  = sababi.
  ⚠ 'the reason why' - turg'un birikma
  (ba'zan 'why' tushirib qoldiriladi:
  'the reason for').

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MATNLARDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to SAVE lives      - hayot saqlab
                       qolmoq
  the LOCAL gym      - mahalliy sport
                       zali
  a(n) ENTRANCE test - kirish testi
  a(n) TRAINING course - o'quv kursi
  WISH me luck       - omad tilang
  to MEET people     - odamlar bilan
                       tanishmoq
  to GET angry       - jahli chiqmoq
  a(n) FULL-TIME job - to'liq stavkali
                       ish
  to work LONG hours - uzoq ishlamoq
  to COMPLETE a course - kursni tugatmoq


⚠ 'A(N)' BELGISI:

  3, 4, 8-bandlarda 'a(n)' bor - demak
  keyingi so'z UNLI bilan boshlanishi
  ham mumkin:
     AN entrance test (e - unli)
     A training course (t - undosh)
     A full-time job (f - undosh)


⚠ 'FULL-TIME' va 'PART-TIME':

  full-time = to'liq stavka (haftasiga
     ~40 soat)
  part-time = yarim stavka

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan, chunki SIFAT
  vazifasida.


⚠ 'TO GET' + SIFAT:

  'to get angry' = jahli chiqmoq
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = HOLAT O'ZGARIShI:
     get tired, get ready, get married,
     get dressed, get better

  ⚠ 29-betdagi 18-mashqda 'get dressed'
  bor edi.


⚠ 'TO WISH SB LUCK':

  = omad tilamoq.
  ⚠ 'luck' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.
  ⚠ 'Good luck!' - eng keng tarqalgan
  shakl.


⚠ 'AN ENTRANCE':

  = kirish (joy yoki imtihon).
  ⚠ 'to enter' = kirmoq (PREDLOGSIZ).
  ⚠ 'an entrance test/exam' = kirish
  imtihoni.


⚠ 'TO COMPLETE' va 'TO FINISH':

  Ikkalasi ham 'tugatmoq', lekin
  'complete' RASMIYROQ va 'to'liq
  bajarmoq' ma'nosini beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.


⚠ 'TO TAKE' va 'TO PASS' A TEST:

  to TAKE a test = testni TOPShIRMOQ
     (jarayon)
  to PASS a test = testdan O'TMOQ
     (natija)
  to FAIL a test = testdan yiqilmoq

  ⚠ 1-gapda 'because he WORKED HARD' -
  demak NATIJA yaxshi → 'PASSED'.


⚠ 'TO LEARN' va 'TO STUDY':

  to learn = o'rganmoq (natija:
     bilim olmoq)
  to study = o'qimoq (jarayon:
     universitetda, maktabda)

  ⚠ Universitetdagi fan uchun HAR DOIM
  'study': 'She STUDIES Architecture
  AT university'.


⚠ 'A JOB' va 'WORK':

  a job = SANALADIGAN ot (aniq ish
     joyi)
     'I have a good job.'
  work = SANALMAYDIGAN ot (umuman ish)
     'He does good work.'

  ⚠ 'a good work' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'to do work' - 'to make' EMAS.

  ⚠ 27-betdagi 7-mashqda ham 'work' va
  'task' farqi tushuntirilgan edi.


⚠ 'SICK' va 'ILL':

  ⚠ Britaniyada:
     'ill' - OTDAN OLDIN TURMAYDI
        ('He is ill.' ✓,
         'an ill man' ✗)
     'sick' - otdan oldin turadi
        ('sick people' ✓)

  ⚠ 4-gapda 'sick PEOPLE' - ot bor,
  shuning uchun 'SICK'.

  ⚠ AQShda 'sick' ikkala holatda ham
  ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'to be sick' Britaniyada yana
  'qusmoq' ma'nosida ham bo'ladi.


⚠ 'ARCHITECTURE':

  = me'morchilik.
  ⚠ 'ch' bu yerda /k/ deb o'qiladi:
  /ˈɑːkɪtektʃə/.
  ⚠ Fan nomi - KATTA harf bilan.

tasks.prompt: 1  He ___ the test because he worked hard.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'because he WORKED HARD' - demak NATIJA
yaxshi → 'PASSED' (testdan o'tdi).

⚠ UMUMIY QOIDA:

     make a mistake, make a phone call

     do the shopping, do your best

  ⚠ Lekin qoida MUTLAQ EMAS - ko'p
  ibora YoDLANADI.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

     make mistakes    - xato qilmoq
     make a phone call - qo'ng'iroq
                        qilmoq
     make the beds    - to'shak yig'moq
     make a cup of coffee - qahva
                        tayyorlamoq
     make a noise     - shovqin qilmoq

     do my homework   - uy vazifasini
                        bajarmoq
     do the washing-up - idish yuvmoq
     do the shopping  - xarid qilmoq
     do the ironing   - dazmol qilmoq
     do my best       - qo'lidan kelganini
                        qilmoq


⚠ DIQQAT - 'MAKE THE BEDS':

  ⚠ 'to MAKE the bed' = to'shakni
  yig'moq/solmoq.
  ⚠ 'to do the bed' - XATO.
  ⚠ 14-betdagi 13-mashqda va 17-betdagi
  maqolda ham bor edi.


⚠ UY YUMUShLARI - HAMMASI 'DO':

  do the washing-up, do the shopping,
  do the ironing, do the housework,
  do the cleaning

  ⚠ 12-betdagi 1a mashqida o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO DO ONE'S BEST':

  = qo'lidan kelganini qilmoq.
  ⚠ "I'll do my best." - juda ko'p
  ishlatiladigan ibora.


⚠ 'TO MAKE A NOISE':

  = shovqin qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'noise' - SANALMAYDIGAN ham,
  sanaladigan ham bo'ladi.
  ⚠ 33-betdagi 9-mashqda 'a strange
  noise' bor edi.

MISTAKES".

YaRATASIZ.
⚠ 'to do a call' - XATO.

⚠ 'to DO homework' - VAZIFA bajariladi.
⚠ 'to make homework' - XATO.
⚠ 12-betdagi 1a mashqida o'rganilgan.

⚠ ISTISNO: uy yumushi bo'lsa ham 'MAKE'!
⚠ 'to make the bed' = to'shakni solmoq/yig'moq.
⚠ 17-betdagi maqolda ham bor edi.

⚠ Uy yumushi → 'DO'.
⚠ 'the washing-up' = IDISh yuvish
('the washing' = KIR yuvish - ADAShTIRMANG).

⚠ Biror narsa YaRATISh → 'MAKE'.
⚠ 'to make coffee/tea/a cake' - hammasi 'make'.

⚠ Tovush HOSIL QILINADI → 'MAKE'.
⚠ 'Don't make a noise!' = shovqin qilmang!

⚠ Uy yumushi → 'DO'.
⚠ 'to DO the shopping' (xarid qilish) va
'to GO shopping' (do'konga borish) - biroz
boshqa ma'no.

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MATNLARDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to be ready FOR a test

  IN September
     = sentyabrda
  to work AS a barman

  IN Rome

  AT the moment
     = ayni damda
  to get a job IN my uncle's bar
     = amakimning barida ish topmoq
  to study Medicine AT university
     = universitetda tibbiyot o'qimoq


⚠ 'AS' - KASB OLDIDAN:

  'to work AS a barman'
  ⚠ 'to work LIKE a barman' - boshqa
  ma'no: 'barmenga o'xshab ishlamoq'
  (lekin barmen emas).

  ⚠ 16-betdagi matnda ham bor edi:
  'I used to work AS A cleaner'.


⚠ 'AT UNIVERSITY' - ARTIKLSIZ:

  'to study AT university'
  ⚠ Britaniyada artikl YO'Q, chunki
  MAQSAD ko'zda tutilyapti (o'qish).
  ⚠ AQShda 'at THE university'.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'at school',
  'at work', 'in hospital',
  'in prison'.


⚠ 'IN' va 'AT' - JOY UChUN:

  IN Rome (shahar - katta joy)
  IN my uncle's bar (ichida)
  AT university (muassasa - MAQSAD)

  ⚠ 'AT the bar' ham mumkin, lekin
  u 'peshtaxta oldida' ma'nosini
  beradi.


⚠ 'AT THE MOMENT':

  = ayni damda.
  ⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi
  (10-betdagi grammatika).


⚠ 'READY FOR' va 'READY TO':

  ready FOR + OT: 'ready for a test'
  ready TO + FE'L: 'ready to start'

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'ready FOR' + OT.
⚠ 'ready TO' + FE'L: 'ready to start'.

⚠ OY oldidan 'IN'.
⚠ Kun oldidan 'ON'; aniq soat oldidan 'AT'.

⚠ KASB oldidan 'AS'.
⚠ 'work LIKE a barman' = barmenga o'xshab
ishlamoq (lekin barmen emas) - BOShQA ma'no.

⚠ ShAHAR oldidan 'IN'.
⚠ Aniq manzil oldidan 'AT': 'at 5 Green Street'.

⚠ 'AT the moment' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi.

RASMIY XAT - TO'LIQ MATN.


1-XATBOSHI (reason for writing):

  'I am WRITING regarding your
  advertisement in The Broadmoor
  Weekly on 20th April. I am very
  interested in visiting Sri Lanka
  and WOULD be grateful if you could
  answer a FEW questions.'


2-XATBOSHI (questions):

  'Your advertisement states that the
  price includes a return flight FROM
  Heathrow. ... Will I have my own
  room, or will I HAVE to share? ...
  Will there be time to go SHOPPING?
  Also, will the guide speak English?'


3-XATBOSHI (closing remarks):

  'Thank you for your help. I look
  FORWARD to hearing from you.'
  'Yours faithfully, Darren Barnet'


⚠ 'I AM WRITING REGARDING ...':

  Rasmiy xatning STANDART boshlanishi.
  ⚠ 'regarding' = haqida, xususida
  ('about' ning RASMIY shakli).


⚠ 'I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU COULD
   ...':

  Juda muloyim iltimos qolipi.
  ⚠ 'Please answer' dan ANChA
  rasmiyroq.


⚠ 'A FEW QUESTIONS':

  ⚠ 'a FEW' - SANALADIGAN otlar bilan
  (a few questions).
  ⚠ 'a LITTLE' - sanalmaydigan bilan
  (a little water).
  ⚠ 'a' oldindan turgani uchun 'few'
  yagona to'g'ri javob.


⚠ 'I LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM
   YOU':

  Rasmiy xatning STANDART tugashi.
  ⚠ 'to' dan keyin -ING shakli!
  'look forward to HEARING'
  ⚠ 'look forward to hear' - XATO!
  Bu yerdagi 'to' PREDLOG, infinitiv
  belgisi emas.


⚠ 'YOURS FAITHFULLY' va
   'YOURS SINCERELY':

  Dear Mr Brown → Yours SINCERELY

  ⚠ Ism NOMA'LUM bo'lsa 'faithfully'.
  ⚠ Xat 'Dear Sir/Madam' bilan
  boshlangani uchun 'faithfully'
  to'g'ri.

    → With 'I look forward to hearing

    How can you tell?

      • rasmiy so'zlar: 'regarding',

        'In addition', 'Finally'

        'I would be grateful if you
         could ...'
      • 'Dear Sir/Madam' +
        'Yours faithfully'

  5 How many paragraphs are there?
    → THREE (3).

  6 Which heading matches each
    paragraph?
    → 1-xatboshi: REASON FOR WRITING
      2-xatboshi: QUESTIONS
      3-xatboshi: CLOSING REMARKS


⚠ RASMIY XAT UCh XATBOShIDAN:

  1) Yozish sababi

     grateful / regarding / Yours

     I'm writing / Can you tell me /

     qilmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
5-UNITNING ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI:
KELASI ZAMONNING UCh ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1) BE GOING TO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  YaSALIShI:
     am/is/are + going to + FE'L

     I AM going to buy a hat.
     He IS going to fall.
     They ARE going to travel.

  INKOR:
     I'm NOT going to ...
     He ISN'T going to ...

  SAVOL:
     AM I going to ...?
     IS he going to ...?


  QAChON IShLATILADI:

  a) OLDINDAN O'YLANGAN REJA,
     NIYaT
     "I'm going to buy a hat."
     (allaqachon qaror qilgan)

  b) KO'RIB TURGANIMIZGA
     ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN
     "Look at him! He's going to
      fall!"
     (⚠ DALIL KO'Z OLDIMIZDA:
      to'lqinda qiyshayib turibdi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  2) WILL                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  YaSALIShI:
     will + FE'L (BARCha shaxsda bir xil)

     I WILL take these.
     He WILL get warmer.

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
     'will TO take' - XATO!

  QISQARTMA:
     I'll, you'll, he'll, we'll, they'll
     INKOR: won't (= will not)


  QAChON IShLATILADI:

  a) ShU ONDA QABUL QILINGAN QAROR
     (on-the-spot decision)
     "I'LL TAKE these, please."
     (bozorda ko'rdi - shu zahoti
      qaror qildi)

  b) O'YLAGANIMIZGA yoki
     TASAVVUR QILGANIMIZGA
     ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN
     'I THINK the weather WILL get
      warmer soon.'
     (⚠ DALIL YO'Q - shunchaki
      fikr, taxmin)

  ⚠ 'I think', 'I'm sure', 'I hope',
  'probably', 'maybe' - HAMMASI
  'will' bilan yuradi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  3) PRESENT CONTINUOUS           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja
    (a fixed arrangement)

  "She's MOVING house ON TUESDAY."
  "I'M GETTING a job next summer."

  ⚠ Odatda VAQT ko'rsatiladi
  (on Tuesday, next summer,
   at 7 o'clock).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG MUHIM FARQ                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'RIB TURIBMAN → be going to
     "Look at those clouds!
      It's GOING TO rain."

  O'YLAYMAN → will
     "I think it WILL rain
      tomorrow."

  ShU ZAHOTI QAROR → will
     (Telefon jiringlaydi)
     "I'LL answer it!"

  OLDINDAN QAROR → be going to
     "I'M GOING TO answer all my
      emails tonight."

  ochib beradi.

  mumkin.

TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Great party, Pam! By the way,
     what 1) ARE YOU GOING TO do

  P: 2) I'M GOING TO travel around
     Australia for a year. Actually,
     3) I'M PICKING UP my ticket
     tomorrow. I can't wait! What
     about you?
  A: I'm not sure. Maybe 4) I'LL work
     for my father for a while, but
     after that, I don't know.
     Hang on, let me get a drink ...
  P: 5) I'LL get you one. What would
     you like?
  A: 6) I'LL have a glass of Coke,
     please.
  P: Okay. Oh, was that the doorbell?
     Tim, 7) WILL you open the door,
     please?

     Coke.


⚠ HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1 'are you going to' - REJA
    haqida so'rayapti
  2 "I'm going to" - oldindan

  3 "I'm picking up" - ANIQ
    kelishilgan ish ('tomorrow')
  4 "I'll" - 'MAYBE' + 'I'M NOT SURE'
    → aniq emas
  5 "I'll" - ShU ZAHOTI taklif qildi
  6 "I'll" - ShU ZAHOTI buyurtma berdi
  7 'will you' - ILTIMOS
    ('Will you ...?' = iltimos qilish)
  8 "I'll" - ShU ZAHOTI va'da berdi

  'Will you open the door, please?'
  = Eshikni ochib bering, iltimos.

  bu yerda MOS EMAS - u REJA haqida

⚠ 'GRADUATION':

⚠ 'HANG ON':

  = shoshma, kut.
  ⚠ 'Hold on' ham xuddi shu ma'noda.


⚠ "I CAN'T WAIT!":

  = Sabrim chidamayapti!
  ⚠ Katta hayajonni bildiradi.


⚠ 'FOR A WHILE':

  = bir muddat, bir oz vaqt.


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = olib kelmoq, olib ketmoq.
  ⚠ 'pick up my ticket' = chiptamni

exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART GAPLARI
(CONDITIONALS TYPE 1).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  WILL + INFINITIVE (to SIZ)

     IF you DON'T HURRY UP,
     you WILL MISS the bus.

     IF I HAVE enough money,
     I'LL MOVE to a bigger house.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG KATTA XATO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ⚠ 'IF' dan keyin 'WILL' IShLATMANG!

     ✗ If you will hurry up, ...
     ✓ If you HURRY UP, ...

  ⚠ 'if' bo'lagida PRESENT SIMPLE,
  asosiy gapda 'will'.

  ⚠ Bu o'zbek tilidan farq qiladi:
  o'zbekchada IKKALA bo'lakda ham
  kelasi zamon bo'lishi mumkin.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QAChON IShLATILADI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAQIQIY yoki JUDA EhTIMOLLI
  vaziyatlar - hozir yoki kelajakda.

  ⚠ 'If it rains, I'll stay at home.'
  (yomg'ir yog'ishi ehtimoli bor)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VERGUL QOIDASI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'if' bo'lagi OLDIN kelsa - VERGUL:
     'If it rains, I'll stay home.'

  'if' bo'lagi KEYIN kelsa - VERGUL
  YO'Q:
     'I'll stay home if it rains.'


⚠ 'INFINITIVE WITHOUT TO':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv, ya'ni fe'lning
  ASOSIY shakli.
  ⚠ 'will TO miss' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'will MISS' ✓


⚠ 'TO HURRY UP':

  = shoshilmoq.
  ⚠ 'Hurry up!' = Tezroq!


⚠ 'PROBABLE':

  = ehtimolli.
  ⚠ 'probably' = ehtimol (ravish).

exercises.instructionUz: When · If
exercises.explanationUz:
'WHEN' va 'IF' FARQI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHEN = ANIQ bo'ladi             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'WHEN I go into town, I'll buy you
   a newspaper.'

  ⚠ Men shaharga ALBATTA boraman -
  faqat qachonligi noma'lum.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IF = ANIQ EMAS                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'IF I go into town, I'll buy you
   a newspaper.'

  ⚠ Men shaharga borishim ham,
  bormasligim ham mumkin.


⚠ IKKALASIDAN KEYIN HAM PRESENT
   SIMPLE:

  ✗ When I WILL go into town, ...
  ✓ When I GO into town, ...

  ⚠ 'when' KELAJAK haqida bo'lsa ham
  PRESENT SIMPLE!

  ⚠ Lekin 'when' SAVOL bo'lsa,
  'will' bo'ladi:
     'WHEN WILL you go into town?'


⚠ ESLAB QOLISh:

  ALBATTA bo'ladi → when
  BALKI bo'lar → if

exercises.instructionUz: Kerak joyda if yoki when qo'ying va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri shaklga soling.
exercises.explanationUz:
UZUN DIALOG - 15 BO'Sh JOY.


⚠ HAR SAFAR SO'RANG:

  ANIQ bo'ladimi? → when
  ANIQ emasmi? → if


TO'LIQ MATN:

  A: Now, about Saturday. I'm going
     to catch the 7:15 train, so I
     expect I'll reach the station at
     around 8:45. I 1) 'LL CALL you
     2) WHEN I 3) GET there.
  B: Okay, but 4) IF I 5) 'M NOT at
     home, I 6) 'LL BE on my way.
  A: Great. Now, where exactly shall
     I meet you?
  B: Ah, yes. 7) WHEN you 8) GET OFF
     the train, you 9) 'LL SEE a
     flight of stairs. Go down the
     stairs, and 10) WHEN you
     11) REACH the bottom, you
     12) 'LL BE on Farmer Street.
     There's a café there called Café
     Rouge. You can wait outside. But
     13) IF it 14) 'S wet, I 15) 'LL
     MEET you inside.
  A: Right. See you on Saturday.
  B: Yes. See you then.


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'WHEN'?

  2) 'when I get there' - u ALBATTA
     yetib boradi
  7) 'when you get off the train' -
     u ALBATTA tushadi
  10) 'when you reach the bottom' -
     u ALBATTA yetib boradi


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'IF'?

  4) "if I'm not at home" - uyda
     bo'lmasligi ANIQ EMAS
  13) "if it's wet" - yomg'ir
     yog'ishi ANIQ EMAS


⚠ 'A FLIGHT OF STAIRS':

  = zinapoya marshi (bir qavatlik
  zinalar to'plami).
  ⚠ 'flight' bu yerda 'parvoz' EMAS!


⚠ 'TO GET OFF' va 'TO GET ON':

  get off = tushmoq (poyezd,
     avtobus, samolyot)
  get on = chiqmoq

  ⚠ Mashina uchun 'get IN' / 'get OUT
  OF'.


⚠ 'ON MY WAY':

  = yo'ldaman.
  ⚠ "I'm on my way!" - juda ko'p
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'SHALL':

  'Where shall I meet you?'
  ⚠ 'shall' - taklif yoki maslahat
  so'raganda ('I' va 'we' bilan).
  ⚠ 'Where will I meet you?' ham
  mumkin, lekin 'shall' rasmiyroq.


⚠ VAQT O'QILIShI:

  7:15 → 'seven fifteen' yoki
     'quarter past seven'
  8:45 → 'eight forty-five' yoki
     'quarter to nine'

exercises.explanationUz:
ShIFOKORGA NAVBAT OLISh.


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Good morning. I 1) 'D LIKE to
     see Dr Franks, please.
  B: I 2) 'M AFRAID you 3) 'LL have
     to make an appointment. He's
     very busy at the moment. Let me
     see - 4) WOULD tomorrow morning
     at 11:15 be all right for you?
  A: 5) COULD you make it a bit
     later?
  B: Certainly. Is 1:30 better?
  A: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very
     much.
  B: You're welcome.


⚠ "I'D LIKE TO ...":

  = ... qilmoqchiman (muloyim).
  ⚠ "I want to" dan ANChA muloyim.
  ⚠ "I'd" = 'I would'.


⚠ "I'M AFRAID ...":

  = afsuski, kechirasiz.
  ⚠ 'qo'rqaman' ma'nosida EMAS!
  ⚠ Yomon xabarni yumshatish uchun.


⚠ "YOU'LL HAVE TO ...":

  = ... qilishingizga to'g'ri keladi.
  ⚠ 'have to' ning kelasi zamoni.
  ⚠ 'you must' dan muloyimroq.


⚠ 'WOULD ... BE ALL RIGHT FOR YOU?':

  = ... sizga to'g'ri keladimi?
  ⚠ Taklif qilishning muloyim shakli.


⚠ 'COULD YOU ...?':

  = ... qila olasizmi?
  ⚠ 'Can you' dan muloyimroq.


⚠ 'TO MAKE AN APPOINTMENT':

  = navbat olmoq, uchrashuvga
  yozilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to make' bilan - 'to do' EMAS.


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  'Could you make it a bit later?'
  = Biroz kechroq qila olasizmi?
  ⚠ 'to make it' = vaqtni kelishmoq.


⚠ 'A BIT':

  = biroz.
  ⚠ 'a little' bilan bir xil, lekin
  so'zlashuvda ko'proq.


⚠ "YOU'RE WELCOME":

  = arzimaydi.
  ⚠ 'Thank you' ga javob.


⚠ 'DR' QISQARTMASI:

  ⚠ Britaniyada NUQTASIZ: 'Dr Franks'.
  ⚠ AQShda nuqta bilan: 'Dr. Franks'.

exercises.explanationUz:
ONA ESLATADI - FARZAND TINChLANTIRADI.


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Remember, it's chilly where
     you're going, so pack some warm
     clothes.
  J: I know, Mum, I 1) WILL.
  A: And the roads might be icy, so
     please don't drive too fast.
  J: Don't worry, Mum, I 2) WON'T.
  A: Don't forget to lock everything
     before you leave.
  J: I 3) WON'T.
  A: Do you promise to call me when
     you get there?
  J: Yes, Mum, I 4) WILL, I promise,
     but stop worrying! I'm going to
     have a great time!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOIDA - JUDA MUHIM              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Ona TASDIQ gap aytsa
  ('pack some clothes',
   'do you promise?')
     → 'I WILL' (qilaman)

  Ona INKOR gap aytsa
  ("don't drive", "don't forget")
     → "I WON'T" (qilmayman)

  ⚠ Javob onaning gapiga QARAB
  o'zgaradi!


⚠ 3-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  A: "DON'T FORGET to lock ..."
  J: "I WON'T." = unutmayman

  ⚠ 'I will' bo'lsa 'unutaman' degan
  ma'no chiqardi - NOTO'G'RI!


⚠ 'CHILLY':

  = salqin, sovuqroq.
  ⚠ 'cold' dan yengilroq.


⚠ 'ICY':

  = muzli.
  ⚠ 'ice' + '-y' ('e' TUShADI).


⚠ 'MIGHT':

  'the roads MIGHT be icy'
  = yo'llar muzli BO'LIShI MUMKIN.
  ⚠ 'may' bilan bir xil, lekin
  ehtimoli kamroq.


⚠ 'TO PACK':

  = joylamoq (chamadonga).
  ⚠ 'to unpack' = bo'shatmoq.


⚠ 'TO LOCK':

  = qulflamoq.
  ⚠ 'to unlock' = qulfni ochmoq.


⚠ 'TO PROMISE':

  = va'da bermoq.
  ⚠ 'I promise' - juda ko'p
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'STOP WORRYING!':

  ⚠ 'stop' dan keyin -ING.
  ⚠ 'stop to worry' BOShQA ma'no:
  'xavotir olish uchun to'xtamoq'.

RASMIY XAT YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  UCh XATBOShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  BOShLANIShI: 'Dear Sir/Madam,'

  1-XATBOShI: YoZISh SABABI
     'I am writing regarding your
      advertisement ...'

  2-XATBOShI: SAVOLLAR
     'Will ...? Could you tell me
      ...?'

  3-XATBOShI: YaKUNIY SO'ZLAR
     'I look forward to hearing from
      you.'

  TUGAShI: 'Yours faithfully,'
     + TO'LIQ ISM


⚠ 'DEAR SIR/MADAM' → 'YOURS
   FAITHFULLY':

  ⚠ Bu JUFTLIK - har doim birga.
  ⚠ Ism ma'lum bo'lsa:
     'Dear Mr Smith' →
     'Yours sincerely'.


⚠ TO'LIQ ISM ShART:

  ⚠ Rasmiy xatda faqat ism emas,
  ISM VA FAMILIYa yoziladi:
  'Darren Barnet' (37-betdagi xat).


⚠ RASMIY XAT BELGILARI:

  • QISQARTMA YO'Q ('I am', "I'm"
    emas)
  • rasmiy so'zlar: regarding,
    states, mentions, In addition,
    Finally
  • muloyim qoliplar: 'I would be
    grateful if you could ...'
  • so'zlashuv iboralari YO'Q

sentencePatterns.formula: I like [-ING], so I'm going to be a [kasb].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like meeting people, so I'm going to be a barman.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odamlar bilan tanishishni yoqtiraman, shuning uchun barmen bo'laman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'so' - NATIJA bog'lovchisi.
⚠ 'be going to' - oldindan o'ylangan NIYaT.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Gardeners have to be patient, imaginative and careful.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog'bonlar sabrli, tasavvuri boy va ehtiyotkor bo'lishi kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'have to' = zarurat.
⚠ Umumiy gap uchun KO'PLIK va ARTIKLSIZ.

sentencePatterns.formula: Which job would you most like to do? - I'd like to work as a [kasb].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Which job would you most like to do? - I'd like to work as a doctor.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qaysi ishni eng ko'p qilishni xohlaysiz? - Shifokor bo'lib ishlashni xohlardim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'would like' - 'want' dan MULOYIM.
⚠ 'to work AS A doctor' - 'as' va artikl ShART.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'd like to be a [kasb], because I [sabab].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like to be a firefighter, because I want to save lives.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O't o'chiruvchi bo'lishni xohlardim, chunki hayot saqlab qolishni istayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'because' - SABAB bog'lovchisi.
⚠ 'so' bilan bir xil fikr, lekin TESKARI
tartibda.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've always wanted to be a [kasb] because I want to [sabab].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've always wanted to be a firefighter because I want to save lives.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men doim o't o'chiruvchi bo'lishni xohlaganman, chunki hayot saqlab qolishni istayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I've always wanted" - PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'because' - SABAB bog'lovchisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A [kasb] has to [fe'l]. A [kasb] doesn't have to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A doctor has to work long hours. A doctor doesn't have to travel a lot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shifokor uzoq ishlashi kerak. Shifokor ko'p sayohat qilishi shart emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "doesn't have to" = ShART EMAS (taqiq EMAS!).
⚠ "mustn't" esa TAQIQ - butunlay boshqa ma'no.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going to begin a training course in September.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'be going to' - oldindan o'ylangan NIYaT.
⚠ 'IN September' - oy oldidan 'in'.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm getting a job in [joy] next [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm getting a full-time job in my uncle's bar next summer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kelasi yozda amakimning barida to'liq stavkali ish olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja
('a fixed arrangement').

sentencePatterns.formula: I wouldn't like to work as a [kasb] because I don't like [-ING].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I wouldn't like to work as a pilot because I don't like travelling a lot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uchuvchi bo'lib ishlashni xohlamas edim, chunki ko'p sayohat qilishni yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "wouldn't like" - "don't want" dan MULOYIM.
⚠ 'like' dan keyin -ING shakli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm going to buy a hat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ OLDINDAN o'ylangan REJA/NIYaT.

sentencePatterns.formula: am/is/are + going to + FE'L (ko'rgan dalil asosida)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at him! He's going to fall!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ DALIL KO'Z OLDIMIZDA → 'be going to'.
⚠ 'will' bu yerda MOS EMAS.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'll take these, please.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ShU ZAHOTI qabul qilingan qaror.
⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think the weather will get warmer soon.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'I think/I'm sure/I hope' → 'will'.
⚠ DALIL yo'q, faqat fikr.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's moving house on Tuesday.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS = KELIShILGAN ish.
⚠ ANIQ VAQT bo'lishi shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is + ega + going to + FE'L ...? - Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is Robin going to travel abroad? No, he isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Robin chet elga sayohat qiladimi? Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Savolda 'is' EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ Qisqa javobda 'going to' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: The [narsa] is [sifat]. - Sorry, madam. I'll [fe'l] it for you.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The glass is chipped. - Sorry, madam. I'll replace it for you.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bokal chetlangan. - Kechirasiz, xonim. Sizga almashtirib beraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ofitsiant ShU ZAHOTI qaror qiladi → "I'll".
⚠ Olmosh 'it' fe'ldan keyin.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will you open the door, please?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Will you ...?' = ILTIMOS, reja haqida savol
EMAS.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't worry. I won't be late.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ "won't" = 'will not' - VA'DA (inkor).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am writing regarding your advertisement in The Broadmoor Weekly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: The Broadmoor Weekly'dagi e'loningiz yuzasidan yozyapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Rasmiy xatning STANDART boshlanishi.
⚠ QISQARTMA YO'Q: 'I am', "I'm" emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: I would be grateful if you could [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would be grateful if you could answer a few questions.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bir necha savolga javob bersangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Eng muloyim iltimos qolipi.
⚠ 'a FEW' - sanaladigan otlar bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I look forward to hearing from you.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to' PREDLOG → keyin -ING!
⚠ 'look forward to hear' - XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will there be time to go shopping?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'There is/are' ning kelasi zamoni -
'There will be'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If you don't hurry up, you will miss the bus.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'if' dan keyin 'will' IShLATMANG!
⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: What will you do if + PRESENT SIMPLE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What will you do if you haven't got any money?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Savolda ham 'if' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shaharga borganimda senga gazeta olib beraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'when' = ALBATTA bo'ladi.
⚠ 'when' dan keyin ham PRESENT SIMPLE.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like to see Dr Franks, please.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ "I'd like" - "I want" dan ancha muloyim.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm afraid you'll have to make an appointment.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I'm afraid" = afsuski, 'qo'rqaman' EMAS.
⚠ "you'll have to" - 'you must' dan muloyimroq.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would [kun] at [vaqt] be all right for you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would tomorrow morning at 11:15 be all right for you?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'Would ... be all right?' - muloyim taklif.

sentencePatterns.formula: Could you make it a bit later?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Could you make it a bit later?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Could you' - 'Can you' dan muloyimroq.
⚠ 'to make it' = vaqtni kelishmoq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pack some warm clothes. - I know, Mum, I will.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Issiq kiyim ol. - Bilaman, oyi, olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ TASDIQ buyruqqa → 'I WILL'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't forget to lock everything. - I won't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKOR buyruqqa → "I WON'T".
⚠ 'I will' bo'lsa TESKARI ma'no chiqadi!

sentencePatterns.formula: I am writing regarding your advertisement for [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am writing regarding your advertisement for a four-day rafting trip.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'rt kunlik rafting sayohati haqidagi e'loningiz yuzasidan yozyapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Rasmiy xatning 1-xatboshi.
⚠ QISQARTMA YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will waterproof clothing be provided?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbat - rasmiy uslubda ko'p.
⚠ 'will be' + 3-shakl.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long will the journey from Denver take?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to take' bu yerda = vaqt olmoq.
⚠ 'take' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Yours faithfully, Darren Barnet
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Dear Sir/Madam' bilan JUFT.
⚠ TO'LIQ ism (ism + familiya) shart.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A carpenter uses a saw.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Kasb + asbob.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A nurse looks after patients in a hospital.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Kasb + vazifa, 3-shaxs -s.

sentencePatterns.formula: [KASB, ko'plik] have to be + SIFAT and SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Waiters have to be polite and patient.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ofitsiantlar odobli va sabrli bo'lishlari kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'have to be' = bo'lishi kerak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tim works as a gardener at the Hotel Royale.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tim Royale mehmonxonasida bog'bon bo'lib ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'as' + kasb, 'at' + joy.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is going to + FE'L. (dalilga asoslangan bashorat / reja)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The waiter is going to replace them.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Vaziyat aniq → 'going to'.

sentencePatterns.formula: She is/isn't going to buy + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She isn't going to buy an umbrella.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Reja - tasdiq/inkor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm hungry! - I'll make some sandwiches.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Muammoga darhol taklif.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't forget the tomatoes. - Don't worry, I won't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'won't' - inkor va'da.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'if' qismida will YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: When X + V-s, X will + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When Mark graduates, he'll go to Sydney.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'when' = qachonki (aniq).

sentencePatterns.formula: I'd like to speak to X, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hello. I'd like to speak to Mr Harris, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom. Janob Xarris bilan gaplashmoqchi edim, iltimos.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Telefonda muloyim so'rov.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm afraid + yomon xabar. Would you like to leave a message?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm afraid he's in a meeting. Would you like to leave a message?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Kotib(a) javobi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I am writing regarding your advertisement in [manba].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I am writing regarding your advertisement in the April edition of 'Working Away'.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Working Away' jurnalining aprel sonidagi e'loningiz yuzasidan yozyapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Rasmiy xat boshlanishi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I would be grateful if you could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would be grateful if you could send me some further information.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga qo'shimcha ma'lumot yuborsangiz minnatdor bo'lardim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Juda muloyim so'rov.

sentencePatterns.formula: I would also like to know + SAVOL (bilvosita).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would also like to know how many hours a day staff are required to work.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shuningdek, xodimlar kuniga necha soat ishlashi kerakligini bilmoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Bilvosita savol - so'roq tartibi yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. Tez orada javobingizni intiqlik bilan kutaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'look forward to' + V-ing.
